source_string: Resource packs are applied bottom to top. This means any asset that is in two packs will be overridden by the higher pack. These packs in your world apply on top of your global pack(s).

source_string: Iron golems will fight for you!
translation: Temir golem siz tomonda turib jang qiladi!

source_string: Feed a bone to a wolf to tame it. You can then make it sit or follow you.
translation: Bo'rini xonakilashtirish uchun unga suyak bering. Shundan so'ng uni o'tirg'izib qo'yishingiz yoki orqangizdan ergashtirishingiz mumkin.

source_string: Wearing a pumpkin on your head will keep Endermen from attacking you.
translation: Boshingizga qovoq kiyib olsangiz, Endermenlar sizga hujum qilmaydi.

source_string: Harvest leather from cows, and use it to make armor and books.
translation: Sigirlardan charm olib, undan sovut va kitoblar yasashda foydalaning.

source_string: You can fill an empty bucket with water, lava, milk, powdered snow... and even some mobs.
translation: Bo'sh chelakni suv, lava, sut, yumshoq qor... va hatto ba'zi moblar bilan to'ldirishingiz mumkin.

source_string: Feeding an animal will keep it from despawning. Build a pen to keep your animals safe.
translation: Hayvonlarga ovqat bersangiz, ular yo'qolib ketmaydi. Ularni xavfsiz saqlash uchun katak yoki g'ov yasang.

source_string: Get to your destination faster with a minecart and some rails!
translation: Vagonetka va relslar yordamida manzilingizga tezroq yetib oling!

source_string: Building a portal will allow you to travel to another dimension called the Nether.
translation: Portal qurish sizga boshqa olam — Netherga yo'l ochadi.

source_string: Bonemeal (crafted from a skeleton bone) can be used as a fertilizer and can make things grow instantly!
translation: Suyak uni (skelet suyagidan yasaladi) o'g'it sifatida ishlatiladi va ekinlarni bir zumda o'stiradi!

source_string: Obsidian is created when water hits a lava source block.
translation: Obsidian — suv lava manbaiga tushganda hosil bo'ladi.

source_string: If the source block for water or lava is removed, it will stop the flow completely.
translation: Suv yoki lavaning manba bloki olib tashlansa, uning oqishi butunlay to'xtaydi.

source_string: Blocks that can be used as a light source will melt snow and ice.
translation: Yorug'lik manbai bo'lgan bloklar qor va muzni eritadi. Bunga mash'allar, yorqintoshlar va jek chiroqlari kiradi.

source_string: Take caution when building structures made of wool out in the open, as lightning from thunderstorms can set wool on fire.
translation: Ochiq havoda jundan inshootlar qurishda ehtiyot bo'ling — chaqmoq urib, junni yoqib yuborishi mumkin.

source_string: A single bucket of lava can be used in a furnace to smelt 100 blocks.
translation: Bitta lava chelagi bilan pechda 100 ta blokni eritish mumkin.

source_string: The instrument played by a note block depends on the material beneath it.
translation: Nota bloki chiqaradigan cholg'u ovozi uning ostidagi blok turiga bog'liq.

source_string: Attacking a wolf will cause any wolves nearby to turn hostile and attack you.
translation: Bitta bo'riga qo'l ko'tarsangiz, atrofida bo'lgan barcha bo'rilar dushmanga aylanadi.

source_string: Wolves and iron golems won't attack creepers.
translation: Bo'rilar va temir golemlar creeper'larga hujum qilishmaydi.

source_string: Chickens lay an egg every 5 to 10 minutes.
translation: Tovuqlar har 5–10 daqiqada bittadan tuxum qo'yadi.

source_string: Obsidian can be mined with a diamond pickaxe.
translation: Obsidianni faqat olmos cho'kich bilan qazib olish mumkin.

source_string: Creepers are the easiest obtainable source of gunpowder.
translation: Creeper'lar — porox olishning eng oson yo'li.

source_string: Tame wolves show their health with the position of their tail. Feed them meat to heal them.
translation: Xonakilashtirilgan bo'rilarning qancha joni qolganini dumining joylashuvidan bilib olsa bo'ladi. Ularni davolash uchun go'sht bering.

source_string: Different colored dyes can be made from a variety of materials, cook cactus in a furnace to get green dye!
translation: Har xil rangli bo'yoqlarni turli xil manbalardan olish mumkin. Yashil bo'yoqni olish uchun pechda kaktusni pishiring!

source_string: Pigs that are struck by lightning become zombified piglins.
translation: Chaqmoq urgan cho'chqalar zombilangan piglinlarga aylanadi.

source_string: Sometimes iron golems give flowers to the villager children!
translation: Ba'zan temir golemlar qishloqlik bolalariga gul sovg'a qilishadi!
Otselotlar creeper'larga kim bu yerda xo'jayin ekanligini ko'rsatib qo'yishadi!

source_string: Use seagrass to attract and breed sea turtles.
translation: Dengiz toshbaqalarini o'zingizga jalb qilish va ko'paytirish uchun dengiz o'tlaridan foydalaning.

source_string: Protect baby turtles from hostile mobs!
translation: Mitti toshbaqalarni yovuz moblardan himoya qiling!

source_string: Baby turtles will drop scutes when they grow - these can be crafted into turtle shells.
translation: Mitti toshbaqalar o'sib ulg'ayganida ulardan qalqonchalar tushadi — ulardan toshbaqa qobig'ini yasash mumkin.

source_string: Brew some water breathing potions for underwater exploration!
translation: Suv ostida kezish uchun suv ostida nafas olish damlamasini tayyorlab oling!

source_string: Dolphins can lead you to shipwrecks and underwater ruins, feed them cod and follow their trail!
translation: Delfinlar sizni cho'kkan kemalar va suv osti xarobalariga yetaklab borishi mumkin, ularga treska bering va orqalaridan ergashing!

source_string: Use shears to carve a pumpkin.
There are 3587 types of tropical fish!
Sea pickles can be smelted into lime green dye.
translation: Dengiz bodringlarini pechda pishirib, och yashil bo'yoq olishingiz mumkin.

source_string: Use hay bales to breed Llamas!
translation: Lamalarni ko'paytirish uchun pichan toyidan foydalaning!

source_string: Compasses always point to the world spawn - craft one to find your way!
translation: Kompas har doim dunyoning paydo bo'lish (spavn) nuqtasini ko'rsatadi — yo'lingizni yo'qotmaslik uchun bittasini yasab oling!

source_string: Trade with villagers to obtain food, tools, and even explorer maps!
translation: Qishloqliklar bilan savdo qilib, yegulik, qurollar va hatto tadqiqotchi xaritalarini qo'lga kiriting!

source_string: Did you know you can hold a map in your off-hand?
translation: Xaritaning ikkinchi qo'lingizda ham tutib turishingiz mumkinligini bilarmidingiz?

source_string: Leads can be used on boats.
translation: Arqondan qayiq uchun ham foydalanishingiz mumkin.

source_string: Sneak to walk safely on magma blocks.
translation: Magma bloklari ustida shikastlanmasdan yurish uchun egilib harakatlaning.

source_string: You can gather cobwebs using shears.
translation: O'rgimchak to'rlarini qaychi yordamida yig'ib olishingiz mumkin.

source_string: Tridents are dropped by the Drowned, and can be held or thrown.
translation: Sanchqilar cho'kkanlardan tushadi, ularni qo'lda tutish yoki otish mumkin.

source_string: You can smelt 20 items in a furnace by using a block of dried kelp as fuel.
translation: Pechda bir blok quritilgan laminariyadan yoqilg'i sifatida foydalanib, 20 ta buyumni eritishingiz mumkin.

source_string: Taming a skeleton horse doesn't require a saddle.
translation: Skelet-otni xonakilashtirish uchun egarga hojat yo'q.

source_string: Phantoms are dangerous mobs that appear during the night. Make sure to sleep regularly!
translation: Fantomlar — tunda paydo bo'ladigan xavfli moblardir. Vaqti‑vaqti bilan uxlab turishni unutmang!

source_string: Zombies turn into drowned if they sink underwater.
translation: Zombi suv ostiga cho'ksa, cho'kkanga aylanib qoladi.
Suzish uchun suvda yugurish tugmasini bosing!

source_string: When digging straight up, place a torch at your feet to break any sand or gravel that could potentially fall down on you.
translation: Tepaga qarab qaziyotganingizda, qulab tushishi mumkin bo'lgan qum yoki shag'alni birdan yo'q qilish uchun oyoq ostingizga mash'al qo'ying.

source_string: Shear a Beehive or nest to get Honeycomb, use a Bottle to get honey.
translation: Asalari uyasi yoki arixonadan mum olish uchun qaychidan, asal olish uchun esa shisha idishdan foydalaning.

source_string: Place a campfire under a beehive or nest to harvest honey.
translation: Asalni xavfsiz yig'ib olish uchun arixona yoki asalari uyasi ostiga gulxan yoqing.

source_string: Emerald ores are the rarest ores in Minecraft! They can only be found in mountains and meadows.
translation: Zumrad ma'dani — Minecraft'dagi eng kamyob rudadir! Ularni faqat tog'lar va o'tloqlardan topish mumkin.

source_string: Need diamonds? They get more common as you go deeper.
translation: Olmoslar kerakmi? Qanchalik chuqurroq tushsangiz, ularni topish imkoniyati shunchalik ortadi.

source_string: Frogs eat small and blocky mobs.
translation: Baqalar kichik va kub shaklidagi moblarni yeydi.

source_string: The Allay loves to collect items! If you give it a certain item it will try to collect more of it.
translation: Yuvoshlar buyumlarni to'plashni juda yaxshi ko'radi! Agar unga biror buyum bersangiz, u o'sha buyumdan ko'proq topib kelishga harakat qiladi.

source_string: Frogs pick a variant based on the temperature of the biome the tadpole grow up in.
translation: Itbaliq o'sib ulg'aygan biomning haroratiga qarab o'z turini tanlaydi.

source_string: You can collect tadpoles in buckets.
Ancient cities can be found under mountain ranges.
translation: Qadimiy shaharlarni tog' tizmalari ostidan topishingiz mumkin.

source_string: Allays love music and therefore interact with noteblocks!
translation: Yuvoshlar musiqani juda yoqtirishgani uchun nota bloklari bilan bajonidil o'ynashishadi!

source_string: Use a water bottle on a dirt block to get mud!
translation: Loy olish uchun tuproq blokiga suv shishasini ishlating!

source_string: When wandering in the deep dark, silence is key.
translation: Zulmat qa'rida kezganda, sukunat — eng muhim qoida.

source_string: Some animals will follow you if you have wheat in your hand.
translation: Qo'lingizda bug'doy ushlab tursangiz, ba'zi hayvonlar orqangizdan ergashib yuradi.

source_string: Before you mine diamonds, redstone, or gold, make sure you're using an iron or diamond pickaxe or it won't work.
translation: Olmos, redstone yoki oltin qazib olish uchun temir yoki olmos cho'kichdan foydalaning, aks holda ular tushmaydi.

source_string: Placing two chests side by side will make one large chest.
translation: Ikkita sandiqni yonma‑yon qo'yib ularni bitta katta sandiqqa aylantirsa bo'ladi.

source_string: Can't find any coal for your torches? Try putting some logs in a furnace.
translation: Mash'al uchun ko'mir topa olmayapsizmi? Pechga bir nechta yog'och solib ko'ring.

source_string: Plant some saplings and they'll grow into trees.
translation: Ko'chatlarni eking, ular tez orada daraxt bo'lib o'sib chiqadi.

source_string: Use a hoe to prepare areas of ground for planting.
translation: Ekin ekish uchun yer maydonini tayyorlashda ketmondan foydalaning.

translation: O'zini boshqa birov qilib ko'rsatish yoki boshqalarni aldash va ulardan foydalanish maqsadida ma'lumot tarqatish

translation: Real hayotdagi haddan tashqari zo'ravonlik yoki shafqatsizlik tasvirlari

translation: Kontentni firibgarlik yo'li bilan qo'lga kiritish yoki undan foydalanish

translation: Kimgadir qaratilgan haqoratlar va kamsituvchi so'zlar

translation: Shaxslarga yoki mulkka real hayotda zarar yetkazish niyati

translation: Nafrat guruhlari, terroristik tashkilotlar yoki yomon nom chiqargan shaxslarga ishora

source_string: Topics or content of a sexual nature
Value entered empty or lower than 0. Respawn radius is reset to default value 5.
translation: Kiritilgan qiymat bo'sh yoki 0 dan kichik. Qayta tirilish radiusi birlamchi 5 qiymatiga tiklandi.

source_string: Value entered is too high. Respawn radius is reset to maximum value 128.
translation: Kiritilgan qiymat juda yuqori. Qayta tirilish radiusi maksimal 128 qiymatiga o'rnatildi.

source_string: Respawn within this block radius when you die and no custom spawnpoint is set (max 128)
translation: O'lsangiz va maxsus paydo bo'lish nuqtasi o'rnatilmagan bo'lsa, ushbu blok radiusi ichida qayta tirilasiz (maks. 128)

source_string: Hostile mobs spawn but deal less damage. Hunger bar depletes and drains health down to 5 hearts.
translation: Yovuz moblar paydo bo'ladi, biroq kamroq zarar yetkazadi. Ochlik darajasi pasayib boradi va sog'liqni 5 ta yurak qolguncha kamaytiradi.

source_string: Hostile mobs spawn and deal more damage. Hunger bar depletes and drains all health.
translation: Yovuz moblar paydo bo'ladi va ko'proq zarar yetkazadi. Ochlik darajasi pasayib boradi va butun sog'liqni tugatadi.

source_string: Hostile mobs spawn and deal standard damage. Hunger bar depletes and drains health down to half a heart.
translation: Yovuz moblar paydo bo'ladi va odatiy darajada zarar yetkazadi. Ochlik darajasi pasayib boradi va sog'liqni yarimta yurak qolguncha kamaytiradi.

source_string: No hostile mobs and only some neutral mobs spawn. Hunger bar doesn't deplete and health replenishes over time.
translation: Yovuz moblar paydo bo'lmaydi, faqat ba'zi neytral moblarnigina uchratish mumkin. Ochiqlik darajasi pasaymaydi, sog'liq esa vaqt o'tishi bilan qayta tiklanadi.

source_string: You get to set your own rules through in-game commands on how you and other can interact with the game.
translation: O'yindagi buyruqlar yordamida o'zingiz va boshqalar uchun o'yin qoidalarini o'zingiz o'rnatishingiz mumkin.

source_string: Create, build, and explore without limits. You can fly, have endless materials, and can't be hurt by monsters.
translation: Cheksiz imkoniyatlar bilan yarating, quring va dunyoni kashf eting. Siz ucha olasiz, resurslaringiz tugamaydi va maxluqlar sizga zarar yetkaza olmaydi.

source_string: Explore a mysterious world where you build, collect, craft, and fight monsters.
translation: Quring, resusrlarni to'plang, narsalar yasang va maxluqlarga qarshi kurashib, sirli dunyoni kashf eting.

source_string: You can't respawn if you die. Good luck! You'll need it.
translation: O'lsangiz, qayta tirila olmaysiz. Omad yor bo'lsin! U sizga juda kerak bo'ladi.

source_string: Your world settings will not be saved if you leave.
Global packs are applied to all of your worlds. They are deactivated when “Shared local packs” is turned on.
translation: Global to'plamlar barcha olamlaringizga qo'llaniladi. “Lokal to'plamlarni ulashish” yoqilgan bo'lsa ular o'chiriladi.

translation: Real hayotdagi haddan tashqari zo'ravonlik yoki shafqatsizlik tasvirlari

source_string: Fraudulent acquisition or use of content
translation: Kontentni firibgarlik yo'li bilan qo'lga kiritish yoki undan foydalanish

translation: Kimgadir qaratilgan haqoratlar va kamsituvchi so'zlar

translation: Shaxslarga yoki mulkka real hayotda zarar yetkazish niyati

source_string: Caution: Online play is offered by third-party servers that are not owned, operated, or supervised by Mojang Studios or Microsoft. During online play, you may be exposed to unmoderated chat messages or other types of user-generated content that may not be suitable for everyone.
translation: Diqqat: onlayn o'yinlar Mojang Studios yoki Microsoft kompaniyalariga tegishli bo'lmagan, ular tomonidan boshqarilmaydigan va nazorat qilinmaydigan tashqi serverlar tomonidan taqdim etiladi. Onlayn o'yin jarayonida sizga moderatorlar tomonidan tekshirilmagan chat xabarlari yoki hammaga ham to'g'ri kelmaydigan boshqa turdagi foydalanuvchi kontentlariga duch kelishi mumkin.

source_string: By submitting this report, you confirm that the information you have provided is accurate and complete to the best of your knowledge.
translation: Shikoyat yuborish orqali siz taqdim etgan ma'lumotlar aniq va to'liq ekanligini tasdiqlaysiz.
O'ziga zarar yetkazish yoki o'z joniga qasd qilish
Bolalarga nisbatan shafqatsizlik yoki jinsiy ekspluatatsiya
Boshqalarga zarar yetkazish bilan tahdid qilish

source_string: Sign in or sign up for free to start earning achievements.
translation: Yutuqlarga erishishni boshlash uchun tizimga kiring yoki ro'yxatdan o'ting.

source_string: You can change the look of your character with a Skin Pack from the Store. Select 'Store' on the Main Menu to see what's available.
translation: Qahramoningiz ko'rinishini do'kondagi skinlar to'plami orqali o'zgartirishingiz mumkin. Mavjud skinlar to'plamlarini ko'rish uchun Asosiy menyuda "Do'kon" bo'limini tanlang.

source_string: Iron golems will fight for you!
translation: Temir golem siz tomonda turib jang qiladi!

source_string: Alter the brightness setting to make the game brighter or darker.
translation: O'yinni yorqinroq yoki qorong'iroq qilish uchun yorqinlik sozlamalarini o'zgartiring.

source_string: If you set the game difficulty to Peaceful, your health will automatically regenerate, and no monsters will come out at night!
translation: O'yin qiyinligini "Tinch" rejimiga qo'ysangiz, joningiz avtomatik ravishda tiklanadi va tunda maxluqlar paydo bo'lmaydi!

source_string: Feed a bone to a wolf to tame it. You can then make it sit or follow you.
translation: Bo'rini xonakilashtirish uchun unga suyak bering. Shundan so'ng uni o'tirg'izib qo'yishingiz yoki orqangizdan ergashtirishingiz mumkin.

source_string: Wearing a pumpkin on your head will keep Endermen from attacking you.
translation: Boshingizga qovoq kiyib olsangiz, Endermenlar sizga hujum qilmaydi.

source_string: Sleeping in a bed at night will fast forward the game to dawn, but all players in a multiplayer game need to sleep in beds at the same time.
translation: Karavotda yotsangiz, tun bir zumda o'tib ketadi. Lekin tarmoqli o'yinda buning uchun hamma o'yinchilar bir vaqtda uxlashlari shart.

source_string: Harvest food from pigs, cows, sheep, rabbit, and chickens. Cook and eat it to regain health!
translation: Sigir, qo'y, quyon va tovuqlardan go'sht oling. Sog'liqni tiklash uchun ularni pishirib yeng!

source_string: Harvest leather from cows, and use it to make armor and books.
translation: Sigirlardan charm olib, undan sovut va kitoblar yasashda foydalaning.

source_string: If you have an empty bucket, you can fill it with water, lava, or milk from a cow!
translation: Bo'sh chelak bo'lsa, uni suv, lava yoki sigirdan sog'ib olingan sut bilan to'ldirishingiz mumkin!

source_string: Use a hoe to prepare areas of ground for planting.
translation: Ekin ekish uchun yer maydonini tayyorlashda ketmondan foydalaning.

source_string: Spiders won't attack you during the day - unless you attack them.
translation: O'rgimchaklar kunduzi sizga tegmaydi — agar ularga o'zingiz birinchi bo'lib hujum qilmasangiz.

source_string: Feeding an animal will keep it from despawning. Build a pen to keep your animals safe.
translation: Hayvonlarga ovqat bersangiz, ular yo'qolib ketmaydi. Ularni xavfsiz saqlash uchun katak yoki g'ov yasang.

source_string: Eating cooked food reduces hunger better than eating raw food.
translation: Pishirilgan ovqat xom ovqatga qaraganda ochlikni ancha yaxshi qondiradi.

source_string: Craft torches to light up dark areas. Monsters lurk in the darkness!
translation: Qorong'u joylarni yoritish uchun mash'allar yasang. Maxluqlar faqat zulmatda paydo bo'ladi!

source_string: Get to destinations faster with a minecart and rail!
translation: Vagonetka va relslar yordamida manzilingizga tezroq yetib oling!

source_string: Plant some saplings and they'll grow into trees.
translation: Ko'chatlarni eking, ular tez orada daraxt bo'lib o'sib chiqadi.

source_string: Pigmen won't attack you - unless you attack them.
translation: Zombilangan piglinlar sizga birinchi bo'lib hujum qilmaydi — albatta, ularga o'zingiz tegmasangiz.

source_string: You can change your game spawn point, and skip to dawn by sleeping in a bed.
translation: Karavotda uxlash orqali qayta tirilish nuqtasini o'zgartirishingiz va tunni o'tkazib yuborishingiz mumkin.

source_string: Hit those fireballs back at the Ghast!
translation: Olovli sharlarni Ghast'ning o'ziga qaytarib urib yuboring!

source_string: Building a portal will allow you to travel to another dimension - The Nether.
translation: Portal qurish sizga boshqa olam — Netherga yo'l ochadi.

source_string: Use the right tool for the job! Digging dirt with a shovel is much faster than using a pickaxe!
translation: Har bir ish uchun to'g'ri ish qurolidan foydalaning! Tuproqni belkurak bilan qazish cho'kichga qaraganda ancha tezroq!

source_string: If you can't find any coal for your torches, you can always make charcoal from trees in a furnace.
translation: Mash'al uchun ko'mir topa olmasangiz, pechda yog'ochdan pista ko'mir yasashingiz mumkin.

source_string: Digging straight down or straight up is not a great idea.
translation: To'g'ri pastga yoki to'g'ri tepaga qarab qazish unchalik ham yaxshi fikr emas.

source_string: Bonemeal (crafted from a Skeleton bone) can be used as a fertilizer and can make things grow instantly!
translation: Suyak uni (skelet suyagidan yasaladi) o'g'it sifatida ishlatiladi va ekinlarni bir zumda o'stiradi!

source_string: Creepers explode when they get close to you!
Obsidian is created when water hits a lava source block.
translation: Obsidian — suv lava manbaiga tushganda hosil bo'ladi.

source_string: If the source block for water or lava is removed, it will stop the flow completely.
translation: Suv yoki lavaning manba bloki olib tashlansa, uning oqishi butunlay to'xtaydi.

source_string: Cobblestone is resistant to Ghast fireballs, making it useful for guarding portals.
translation: Chaqirtosh Ghast'ning olov sharlariga chidamli, shu sababli u portallarni himoyalash uchun juda mos keladi.

source_string: Blocks that can be used as a light source will melt snow and ice. This includes torches, glowstones, and Jack-O-Lanterns.
translation: Yorug'lik manbai bo'lgan bloklar qor va muzni eritadi. Bunga mash'allar, yorqintoshlar va jek chiroqlari kiradi.

source_string: Take caution when building structures made of wool out in the open, as lightning from thunderstorms can set wool on fire.
translation: Ochiq havoda jundan inshootlar qurishda ehtiyot bo'ling — chaqmoq urib, junni yoqib yuborishi mumkin.

source_string: A single bucket of lava can be used in a furnace to smelt 100 blocks.
translation: Bitta lava chelagi bilan pechda 100 ta blokni eritish mumkin.

source_string: The instrument played by a note block depends on the material beneath it.
translation: Nota bloki chiqaradigan cholg'u ovozi uning ostidagi blok turiga bog'liq.

source_string: Zombies and Skeletons can survive daylight if they are in water or wearing a helmet.
translation: Zombilar va skeletlar suvda bo'lishsa yoki dubulg'a kiygan bo'lsa, kunduzi tirik qola oladi.

source_string: Attacking a wolf will cause any wolves in the immediate vicinity to turn hostile and attack you. This trait is also shared by Zombie Pigmen.
translation: Bitta bo'riga qo'l ko'tarsangiz, atrofida bo'lgan barcha bo'rilar dushmanga aylanadi. Zombilangan piglinlar ham xuddi shunday to'da bo'lib hujum qiladi.

source_string: Wolves and Iron Golems won't attack Creepers.
translation: Bo'rilar va temir golemlar creeper'larga hujum qilishmaydi.

source_string: Chickens lay an egg every 5 to 10 minutes.
translation: Tovuqlar har 5–10 daqiqada bittadan tuxum qo'yadi.

source_string: Obsidian can only be mined with a diamond pickaxe.
translation: Obsidianni faqat olmos cho'kich bilan qazib olish mumkin.

source_string: Creepers are the easiest obtainable source of gunpowder.
translation: Creeper'lar — porox olishning eng oson yo'li.

source_string: Placing two chests side by side will make one large chest.
translation: Ikkita sandiqni yonma‑yon qo'yib ularni bitta katta sandiqqa aylantirsa bo'ladi.

source_string: Tame wolves show their health with the position of their tail. Feed them meat to heal them.
translation: Xonakilashtirilgan bo'rilarning qancha joni qolganini dumining joylashuvidan bilib olsa bo'ladi. Ularni davolash uchun go'sht bering.

source_string: Different colored dyes can be made from a variety of materials, cook cactus in a furnace to get green dye!
translation: Har xil rangli bo'yoqlarni turli xil manbalardan olish mumkin. Yashil bo'yoqni olish uchun pechda kaktusni pishiring!

source_string: On mobile devices, you can download the "Music by Minecraft" pack from the Music Category in the Minecraft Store.
translation: Mobil qurilmalarda Minecraft do'konining "Musiqa" bo'limidan "Music by Minecraft" to'plamini yuklab olishingiz mumkin.

source_string: Some animals will follow you if you have wheat in your hand.
translation: Qo'lingizda bug'doy ushlab tursangiz, ba'zi hayvonlar orqangizdan ergashib yuradi.

source_string: Gold is more abundant in Mesa biomes!
translation: Mesa biomida oltin boshqa biomlarga qaraganda ancha ko'proq uchraydi!

source_string: Diorite, you either love it or hate it.
translation: Dioritni yo chin dildan sevasiz, yo undan nafratlanasiz.
Odamlar rostdan ham ushbu maslahatlarni o'qisharmikin-a?
Suzish uchun suvda yugurish tugmasini bosing!

source_string: Riptide enchantment will propel you through the air in the rain.
translation: Girdob sehri yomg'irli ob‑havoda sizni to'g'ridan‑to'g'ri osmonga uchirib yuboradi.

source_string: MINECON Earth is a worldwide interactive live-streaming event. Grab your items and join the party!
translation: MINECON Earth — butun dunyo bo'ylab jonli efirda o'tadigan interaktiv tadbirdir. Kerakli narsalaringizni oling-da, bizga qo'shiling!

source_string: The Beacon is a powerful item that can only be crafted with a nether star from the Wither!
translation: Mayoq — g'oyat qudratli narsa, uni faqat Wither'dan tushadigan Nether yulduzi bilan yasash mumkin!

source_string: Did you know that nether stars can't be destroyed by explosions?
translation: Nether yulduzlarini portlatish orqali yo'q qilib bo'lmasligini bilarmidingiz?

source_string: When digging straight up, place a torch at your feet to break any sand or gravel that could potentially fall down on you.
translation: Tepaga qarab qaziyotganingizda, qulab tushishi mumkin bo'lgan qum yoki shag'alni birdan yo'q qilish uchun oyoq ostingizga mash'al qo'ying.
Piglinlar bilan oltin evaziga savdo qilishingiz mumkin

source_string: Shear a Beehive or nest to get Honeycomb, use a Bottle to get honey
translation: Asalari uyasi yoki arixonadan mum olish uchun qaychidan, asal olish uchun esa shisha idishdan foydalaning

source_string: Place a Campfire under a Beehive or nest to harvest honey peacefully. Your bees will thank you.
translation: Asalni tinchgina yig'ib olish uchun arixona yoki asalari uyasi ostiga gulxan yoqing. Arilar sizdan minnatdor bo'lishadi.

source_string: Respawning in the Nether requires a charged Respawn Anchor
translation: Nether'da qayta tirilish uchun quvvatlangan qayta tirilish langari kerak bo'ladi.

source_string: You can charge a Respawn Anchor with Glowstone
translation: Qayta tirilish langarini yorqintosh bilan quvvatlashingiz mumkin

source_string: You can breed Hoglins with Crimson Fungus, but it is dangerous!
translation: Hoglinlarni qirmizi qo'ziqorin bilan ko'paytirishingiz mumkin, ammo bu xavfli!
G'oyangiz bormi? feedback.minecraft.net saytiga tashrif buyuring!

source_string: Allays can be found in Pillager Outposts and Woodland Mansions.
translation: Yuvoshlarni talonchilar avanpostlarida va o'rmondagi qasrlarda topish mumkin.

source_string: The Allay loves to collect items! If you give it a certain item it will try to collect more of it.
translation: Yuvoshlar buyumlarni to'plashni juda yaxshi ko'radi! Agar unga biror buyum bersangiz, u o'sha buyumdan ko'proq topib kelishga harakat qiladi.

source_string: Allays love music and therefore interact with Noteblocks!
translation: Yuvoshlar musiqani juda yoqtirishgani uchun nota bloklari bilan bajonidil o'ynashishadi!

source_string: Ancient cities can be found under mountain ranges.
translation: Qadimiy shaharlarni tog' tizmalari ostidan topishingiz mumkin.

source_string: When wandering in Deep Dark, silence is key.
translation: Zulmat qa'rida kezganda, sukunat — eng muhim qoida.

source_string: Use a water bottle on a dirt block to get mud!
translation: Loy olish uchun tuproq blokiga suv shishasini ishlating!

source_string: Frogs eat small and blocky mobs.
translation: Baqalar kichik va kub shaklidagi moblarni yeydi.

source_string: Frogs pick a variant based on the temperature of the biome the tadpole grow up in.
translation: Itbaliq o'sib ulg'aygan biomning haroratiga qarab o'z turini tanlaydi.

source_string: You can collect tadpoles in buckets.
Need more smithing templates? Try to copy them.
translation: Ko'proq temirchilik shablonlari kerakmi? Ularni nusxalab ko'ring.

source_string: The sniffer egg seems to like moss blocks.
translation: Hidlovchi tuxumiga yo'sin bloklari ko'proq yoqadiganga o'xshaydi.

source_string: Mob heads make sounds, try them out on note blocks!
translation: Mob boshlari tovush chiqaradi, ularni nota bloklariga qo'yib sinab ko'ring!

source_string: Some sand might be suspicious. Use your brush on it to find some good stuff!
translation: Ba'zi qumlar shubhali tuyulishi mumkin. Qiziqarli narsalarni topish uchun unda cho'tkadan foydalaning!

source_string: Two players can ride together on a camel.
translation: Tuya ustida bir vaqtning o'zida ikkita o'yinchi birgalikda minishi mumkin.

source_string: Show the direction of other players in multiplayer
translation: Birga o'ynaganda boshqa o'yinchilarning yo'nalishini ko'rsatadi

source_string: You have been idle for too long.
translation: Siz juda uzoq vaqt harakatsiz turdingiz.

source_string: The amount of camera shake caused by being hurt
translation: Zarar olganda kameraning qanchalik darajada chayqalishini belgilaydi

source_string: Randomly respawn somewhere within this many blocks of where you died (max 128)
translation: O'lgan joyingizdan shu belgilangan blok radiusi oralig'ida tasodifiy joyda qayta tirilasiz (maks. 128)

source_string: Create, build, and explore without limits. You can fly, have endless materials, and can’t be hurt by monsters.
translation: Cheksiz imkoniyatlar bilan yarating, quring va dunyoni kashf eting. Siz ucha olasiz, resurslaringiz tugamaydi va maxluqlar sizga zarar yetkaza olmaydi.

source_string: Explore a mysterious world where you build, collect, craft, and fight monsters.
translation: Quring, resusrlarni to'plang, narsalar yasang va maxluqlarga qarshi kurashib, sirli dunyoni kashf eting.

source_string: Hostile mobs spawn but deal less damage. Hunger bar depletes and drains health down to 5 hearts.
translation: Yovuz moblar paydo bo'ladi, biroq kamroq zarar yetkazadi. Ochlik darajasi pasayib boradi va sog'liqni 5 ta yurak qolguncha kamaytiradi.

source_string: Hostile mobs spawn and deal standard damage. Hunger bar depletes and drains health down to half a heart.
translation: Yovuz moblar paydo bo'ladi va odatiy darajada zarar yetkazadi. Ochlik darajasi pasayib boradi va sog'liqni yarimta yurak qolguncha kamaytiradi.

source_string: No hostile mobs and only some neutral mobs spawn. Hunger bar doesn’t deplete and health replenishes over time.
translation: Yovuz moblar paydo bo'lmaydi, faqat ba'zi neytral moblarnigina uchratish mumkin. Ochlik darajasi pasaymaydi, sog'liq esa vaqt o'tishi bilan qayta tiklanadi.
Mash'um alomat sinov yaratkichini chulg'ab oldi
Mash'um alomat sinov yaratkichini chulg'ab oldi

source_string: Copper Golem is placing an item
Piglin Brute converts to Zombified Piglin
The sound is too far away to be heard
%1$s died because not just the floor is lava
translation: %1$s lava faqat polda emasligini bilib oldi

translation: Bu bir necha daqiqa vaqt olishi mumkin
